project: SISO - Modulos Inventario + Etiquetas de Endereco
description: Migrate physical inventory (stock counting + location updates) and address label printing from Google Sheets + Tiny API v2 to SISO using existing OAuth2, rate limiting, and PrintNode infrastructure.

userStories.title: Database migration for inventario tables
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the inventario database schema created so that all other stories have the foundation to build on.
acceptanceCriteria: Create file supabase/migrations/20260320_modulo_inventario.sql

Table siso_inventarios with columns: id (uuid PK default gen_random_uuid()), empresa_id (uuid NOT NULL FK siso_empresas), galpao_id (uuid NOT NULL FK siso_galpoes), usuario_id (uuid NOT NULL FK siso_usuarios), modo (text NOT NULL CHECK IN ('loc_only','loc_estoque')), tipo_estoque (text nullable CHECK IN ('B','E','S')), status (text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'em_andamento' CHECK IN ('em_andamento','processando','concluido','cancelado')), total_itens (int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0), itens_processados (int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0), itens_sucesso (int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0), itens_erro (int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0), observacoes (text nullable), created_at (timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()), processado_em (timestamptz nullable), concluido_em (timestamptz nullable)

Table siso_inventario_itens with columns: id (uuid PK default gen_random_uuid()), inventario_id (uuid NOT NULL FK siso_inventarios ON DELETE CASCADE), produto_id_tiny (int nullable), sku (text NOT NULL), nome_produto (text nullable), ean (text nullable), localizacao (text NOT NULL), quantidade (int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1), status (text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pendente' CHECK IN ('pendente','processando','sucesso','erro')), erro_msg (text nullable), created_at (timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
Index idx_inventarios_status on siso_inventarios(status)
Index idx_inventarios_empresa on siso_inventarios(empresa_id)
Index idx_inventario_itens_inv on siso_inventario_itens(inventario_id)
Apply migration via Supabase MCP tool apply_migration
Typecheck passes

Add type TipoEstoque = 'B' | 'E' | 'S'
Add type InventarioStatus = 'em_andamento' | 'processando' | 'concluido' | 'cancelado'
Add type InventarioItemStatus = 'pendente' | 'processando' | 'sucesso' | 'erro'
Add interface Inventario with all DB columns plus optional joined fields: empresa_nome, galpao_nome, usuario_nome
Add interface InventarioItem with all DB columns

Add interface InventarioItemConsolidado with: sku (string), produto_id_tiny (number), nome_produto (string), ean (string|null), localizacao_merged (string), quantidade_total (number), itens_ids (string[]), status (InventarioItemStatus), erro_msg (string|null)

Add buscarProdutoPorGtin(token: string, gtin: string) to src/lib/tiny-api.ts — calls GET /produtos with query params gtin={gtin}&situacao=A, returns first product or null. Follow same pattern as buscarProdutoPorSku

userStories.title: Inventario processor business logic
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the core processing logic that consolidates scanned items and sends updates to Tiny ERP.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/inventario-processor.ts
Export function consolidarItens(itens: InventarioItem[]): InventarioItemConsolidado[] — groups by SKU, sums quantities, merges unique locations with '; ' separator, collects all itens_ids
Export async function processarInventario(inventarioId: string): Promise<void>
processarInventario: (1) fetches inventario + items from DB via createServiceClient, (2) sets inventario status='processando' and processado_em=now()
processarInventario: (3) calls consolidarItens, (4) fetches deposito_id from siso_tiny_connections WHERE empresa_id = inventario.empresa_id
processarInventario: (5) if no deposito configured, sets status='erro' on all items with erro_msg='Deposito nao configurado', updates counters, sets inventario status='concluido', returns early
processarInventario: (6) for each consolidated product, uses runWithEmpresa from tiny-queue.ts for rate limiting

processarInventario: (7) if modo='loc_estoque': calls movimentarEstoque(token, produtoId, {tipo: inventario.tipo_estoque, quantidade, deposito: {id: depositoId}}) then atualizarLocalizacaoProduto(token, produtoId, localizacao_merged)
processarInventario: (8) if modo='loc_only': calls only atualizarLocalizacaoProduto(token, produtoId, localizacao_merged)
processarInventario: (9) skips movimentarEstoque for Kit products (check produto type='K' or similar flag)
processarInventario: (10) after each product, updates all corresponding item statuses (sucesso/erro) and inventario counters (itens_processados, itens_sucesso, itens_erro) atomically
processarInventario: (11) when all done, sets inventario status='concluido' and concluido_em=now()
Uses getValidTokenByEmpresa from tiny-oauth.ts for OAuth2 token
Uses logger for structured logging throughout
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Follow same fire-and-forget pattern as execution-worker.ts. Check tiny-queue.ts for runWithEmpresa usage. Check tiny-api.ts for movimentarEstoque and atualizarLocalizacaoProduto signatures.

userStories.title: API routes: list and create inventario
userStories.description: As a developer, I want GET/POST /api/inventario to list inventarios and create new sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/app/api/inventario/route.ts with GET and POST handlers
GET: requires getSessionUser() from session.ts, returns inventarios joined with empresa.nome, galpao.nome, usuario.nome ordered by created_at DESC
GET: also returns counts object: { em_andamento: N, processando: N, concluido: N, cancelado: N }
POST: requires getSessionUser(), body: { empresa_id, galpao_id, modo, tipo_estoque?, observacoes? }. Sets usuario_id from session user
POST: checks if empresa already has em_andamento inventario — returns 409 { error: 'Empresa ja possui um inventario em andamento' }
POST: when modo='loc_only', ignores tipo_estoque (stores null). When modo='loc_estoque', tipo_estoque is required — returns 400 if missing
POST: returns 201 with created inventario record
Error responses use NextResponse.json({ error: '...' }, { status: N })
Uses createServiceClient() from supabase-server.ts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Follow existing API route patterns from src/app/api/pedidos/route.ts or similar. The join for empresa/galpao/usuario names can use Supabase's select syntax with references.

userStories.title: API routes: inventario detail and cancel
userStories.description: As a developer, I want GET/PATCH /api/inventario/[id] to view inventory details and cancel sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/app/api/inventario/[id]/route.ts with GET and PATCH handlers
GET: requires getSessionUser(), returns inventario with joined empresa/galpao/usuario names plus all items ordered by created_at DESC

PATCH: requires getSessionUser(), body can have: status (only 'cancelado' allowed) and/or observacoes (string)
PATCH: only allows cancellation if current status is 'em_andamento' — returns 400 { error: 'Inventario nao pode ser cancelado neste status' } otherwise
PATCH: returns updated inventario
Uses createServiceClient() from supabase-server.ts

userStories.notes: Route params: { params: { id: string } }. Check Next.js 16 App Router pattern for dynamic route params.

userStories.title: API route: coletar (scan item into inventory)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want POST /api/inventario/[id]/coletar to search Tiny by SKU/EAN and insert scanned items into the inventory session.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/app/api/inventario/[id]/coletar/route.ts with POST handler
Requires getSessionUser()
Body: { codigo: string, localizacao: string, quantidade?: number } — quantidade defaults to 1
Validates inventario exists and status is 'em_andamento' — returns 400 if not
Gets OAuth2 token via getValidTokenByEmpresa(inventario.empresa_id) from tiny-oauth.ts
First calls buscarProdutoPorSku(token, codigo), if null then calls buscarProdutoPorGtin(token, codigo)
If product not found by either: returns 404 { error: 'Produto nao encontrado' }

If found: inserts into siso_inventario_itens with produto_id_tiny from Tiny response, sku (produto.codigo), nome_produto (produto.nome or produto.descricao), ean (produto.gtin), localizacao, quantidade
Increments total_itens on parent siso_inventarios record
Returns 201 with the created item including all fields
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Check buscarProdutoPorSku return shape in tiny-api.ts to know which fields to extract (codigo, nome/descricao, gtin, id). Use runWithEmpresa from tiny-queue.ts if needed for rate limiting.

userStories.title: API routes: processar, progresso, and delete item
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the remaining inventory API routes for batch processing, progress polling, and item deletion.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/app/api/inventario/[id]/processar/route.ts — POST handler: validates inventario status is 'em_andamento', calls processarInventario(id) WITHOUT awaiting (fire-and-forget), returns 200 { message: 'Processamento iniciado' } immediately

Create src/app/api/inventario/[id]/progresso/route.ts — GET handler: returns { status, total_itens, itens_processados, itens_sucesso, itens_erro } from siso_inventarios plus array of consolidated items with their current status and erro_msg

Create src/app/api/inventario/[id]/itens/[itemId]/route.ts — DELETE handler: validates inventario status is 'em_andamento', deletes the item from siso_inventario_itens, decrements total_itens on parent inventario, returns 200
All three routes require getSessionUser()
All return 404 if inventario not found
processar returns 400 if inventario is not em_andamento
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: processar fire-and-forget pattern: call processarInventario(id) without await, then respond. The function runs in the background. See execution-worker.ts for a similar pattern. For progresso, use consolidarItens from inventario-processor.ts to build the consolidated view.

userStories.title: ZPL address label generation logic
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the business logic for generating warehouse address combinations and ZPL label code.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/zpl-endereco.ts

Export gerarEnderecos(params: { corredorInicio: string, corredorFim: string, horizontalInicio: string, horizontalFim: string, verticalInicio: string, verticalFim: string }): string[] — generates all address combos in format {corredor}-{horizontal}-{vertical}

Internal function getCorridorRange(start: string, end: string): string[] — handles numeric ranges (e.g., '1' to '5' = ['1','2','3','4','5']), alphabetic ranges (e.g., 'A' to 'E' = ['A','B','C','D','E']), and single values (start === end)

Export gerarZplEtiquetaPequena(enderecos: string[]): string — ZPL with 2 addresses per label side-by-side: each has ^FO positioned text, ^BC Code128 barcode, ^BQ QR code. Label starts with ^XA ends with ^XZ
Export gerarZplEtiquetaGrande(enderecos: string[]): string — ZPL with 1 address per label, 90deg rotation (^FWR), ~250pt font (^A0R,250,250), large text with barcode
gerarEnderecos throws error if any start > end in its range
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: ZPL reference: ^XA=start label, ^XZ=end label, ^FO=field origin(x,y), ^FD=field data, ^FS=field separator, ^BC=Code128, ^BQ=QR code, ^FWR=rotate 90deg, ^A0=scalable font. Pequena label: ~4x1.5 inch thermal. Grande: ~4x6 inch.

userStories.title: API routes: etiquetas preview and print
userStories.description: As a developer, I want API routes to preview generated addresses and send ZPL labels to PrintNode for printing.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/app/api/etiquetas/preview/route.ts — POST handler: body { corredorInicio, corredorFim, horizontalInicio, horizontalFim, verticalInicio, verticalFim }. Calls gerarEnderecos, returns { enderecos: string[], total: number, warning: boolean } where warning=true if total>1000. Returns 400 on invalid range

Create src/app/api/etiquetas/imprimir/route.ts — POST handler: same range params plus tipo ('pequena'|'grande'). Calls gerarEnderecos then gerarZplEtiquetaPequena or gerarZplEtiquetaGrande. Gets user printer via resolverImpressora(userId) from printnode.ts. Sends ZPL via enviarImpressaoZpl from printnode.ts. Returns 200 { message: 'Impressao enviada', total: number }
Both require getSessionUser()
imprimir returns 400 { error: 'Impressora nao configurada' } if no printer found for user
Uses logger for structured logging
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Check printnode.ts for resolverImpressora and enviarImpressaoZpl signatures. Check config.ts for getConfig('PRINTNODE_API_KEY') pattern.
